title: Man. Post. Cap. VIII: poison-spread vs imputation — imputation is God's work
pass_a_gloss: And he counts as cause of a shared ill only if he breathed it into everyone, or at least bred in one an ill that of itself, by its own natural force, ran through all like venom or plague. Charging and laying on penalty are God's doing, not the old serpent's.
pass_b_english: But he is not the cause of a common evil unless either he himself breathed that evil into all, or at least produced in one such an evil as of itself, by its own natural force, spread and propagated itself into all like poison, like a plague. Imputation, the infliction of penalty, is God's work, not the ancient serpent's.
source_text: Non est autem causa mali communis, nisi aut illud ipse omnibus inspiraverit, aut saltem tale malum in uno produxerit, quod sponte, per se, naturali vi sua sese in omnes ut venenum, ut pestis, diffuderit, & propagaverit. Imputatio, inflictio poenae Dei opus est, non serpentis antiqui.

choices.choice: Natural spread like poison; imputation is God's work
